title: Export with nothing matching shows Empty export and saves no file
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • No part at {Location-A}, active or inactive, has a number or description containing {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EMPTYEXP-ZZZ).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Number-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Export.
  5. Wait 5 seconds.
  6. Click the Inactive tab.
  7. Type {Number-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
  8. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  9. Click Export.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The Active tab lists no parts.
  • Step 4: A message reading "Empty export" appears.
  • Step 5: No file has downloaded: the browser shows no new download.
  • Step 9: On the Inactive tab the same message, "Empty export", appears, and no file downloads.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S1-R9b, S1-R9, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour (13 Oct copy). Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 4). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R9b: “The export includes every part on that tab that matches the current search, filters and Supply filter, including parts not yet scrolled into view. With nothing matching, the message "Empty export" shows and no file is made.”
  • S1-R9: “Export in the actions menu exports the parts on the tab that shows: active parts from the Active tab, inactive parts from the Inactive tab.”
